groups.name: iqscaffold
groups.description: Root configuration properties for IQ Scaffold Billing Service. All custom properties use the 'iqscaffold.' prefix for clear namespace separation.

groups.name: iqscaffold.email
groups.description: Email configuration properties for SMTP, sender details, and templates.

groups.name: iqscaffold.email.smtp
groups.description: SMTP server configuration for email sending, including host, port, authentication, and encryption settings.

groups.name: iqscaffold.email.sender
groups.description: Email sender configuration including from address, display name, and base URL for email links.

groups.name: iqscaffold.email.templates
groups.description: Email template paths for various billing notification types.

groups.name: iqscaffold.i18n
groups.description: Internationalization (i18n) configuration for multi-language support, including supported locales and message bundles.

groups.name: iqscaffold.billing
groups.description: Billing-specific configuration including security, payment processing, integrations, and notifications.

groups.name: iqscaffold.billing.security
groups.description: Security configuration for the billing service, including JWT authentication settings.

groups.name: iqscaffold.billing.security.jwt
groups.description: JWT (JSON Web Token) configuration for authentication and authorization.

groups.name: iqscaffold.billing.payment
groups.description: Payment processing configuration including provider selection and SaaS mode settings.

groups.name: iqscaffold.billing.payment.stripe
groups.description: Stripe payment provider configuration for processing payments, webhooks, and Connect integration.

groups.name: iqscaffold.billing.stripe
groups.description: General Stripe configuration for Connect platform operations and merchant onboarding.

groups.name: iqscaffold.billing.notifications
groups.description: Notification system configuration for email and webhook notifications with retry logic.

groups.name: iqscaffold.billing.subscription
groups.description: Subscription management configuration including trial periods, grace periods, retry logic, and proration behavior.

groups.name: iqscaffold.billing.subscription.notifications
groups.description: Subscription-specific notification configuration for trial ending notices and payment retry schedules.

groups.name: iqscaffold.liquibase
groups.description: Liquibase database migration configuration for multi-tenant schema management.

properties.name: iqscaffold.tenant-id-header
properties.description: HTTP header name used to identify the tenant in multi-tenant requests. This header is required for all tenant-scoped API calls.

properties.name: iqscaffold.i18n.supported-locales
properties.description: List of supported locale codes in format 'xx' or 'xx-XX' (e.g., 'en', 'en-US', 'fr', 'es-ES'). The default locale must be included in this list.

properties.name: iqscaffold.i18n.default-locale
properties.description: Default locale code used when no locale is specified or when the requested locale is not supported. Must be in format 'xx' or 'xx-XX' and included in supported-locales.

properties.name: iqscaffold.i18n.message-basename
properties.description: Base name for message resource bundles (e.g., 'messages' will load messages.properties, messages_en.properties, etc.).

properties.name: iqscaffold.i18n.message-cache-duration
properties.description: Duration to cache message bundles. Set to -1 for no caching (useful in development), or a positive duration for production.

properties.name: iqscaffold.i18n.fallback-to-system-locale
properties.description: Whether to fall back to the system locale when the requested locale is not found. If false, always uses the default locale.

properties.name: iqscaffold.i18n.use-code-as-default-message
properties.description: Whether to use the message code as the default message when no message is found. If false, throws an exception for missing messages.

properties.name: iqscaffold.liquibase.tenant-change-log
properties.description: Liquibase changelog file path for tenant-specific schema migrations. Applied to each tenant schema separately.

properties.name: iqscaffold.liquibase.system-change-log
properties.description: Liquibase changelog file path for system-wide (public schema) migrations. Applied once to the public schema.

properties.name: iqscaffold.email.smtp.host
properties.description: SMTP server hostname or IP address for sending emails (e.g., 'smtp.gmail.com', 'smtp.sendgrid.net').

properties.name: iqscaffold.email.smtp.port
properties.description: SMTP server port number. Common values: 587 (STARTTLS), 465 (SSL/TLS), 25 (plain SMTP).

properties.name: iqscaffold.email.smtp.username
properties.description: SMTP server username for authentication. Leave empty if authentication is not required.

properties.name: iqscaffold.email.smtp.password
properties.description: SMTP server password for authentication. Leave empty if authentication is not required. Consider using environment variables or secrets management.

properties.name: iqscaffold.email.smtp.auth
properties.description: Enable SMTP authentication. Set to true if username and password are required.

properties.name: iqscaffold.email.smtp.starttls
properties.description: Enable STARTTLS encryption for SMTP connections. Recommended for port 587.

properties.name: iqscaffold.email.smtp.timeout
properties.description: SMTP connection and socket timeout duration. Format: ISO-8601 duration (e.g., 'PT30S' for 30 seconds).

properties.name: iqscaffold.email.sender.from-email
properties.description: Default 'from' email address for all outgoing billing notification emails.

properties.name: iqscaffold.email.sender.from-name
properties.description: Default 'from' display name shown in email clients for outgoing emails.

properties.name: iqscaffold.email.sender.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for generating clickable links in email templates (e.g., invoice links, dashboard links).

properties.name: iqscaffold.email.templates.merchant-onboarding-template
properties.description: Classpath or file path to the HTML template for merchant onboarding notification emails.

properties.name: iqscaffold.email.templates.payment-successful-template
properties.description: Classpath or file path to the HTML template for successful payment confirmation emails.

properties.name: iqscaffold.email.templates.payment-failed-template
properties.description: Classpath or file path to the HTML template for failed payment notification emails.

properties.name: iqscaffold.email.templates.payment-refunded-template
properties.description: Classpath or file path to the HTML template for payment refund confirmation emails.

properties.name: iqscaffold.email.templates.invoice-generated-template
properties.description: Classpath or file path to the HTML template for invoice generation notification emails.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.security.jwt.jwk-set-uri
properties.description: URI endpoint to fetch the JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) for JWT token validation. Typically points to the authentication service's JWKS endpoint.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.security.jwt.issuer
properties.description: Expected issuer claim ('iss') value in JWT tokens. Tokens with a different issuer will be rejected.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.payment.provider
properties.description: Payment provider to use for processing transactions. Valid values: 'stripe' for production, 'manual' for testing/development.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.payment.saas-mode
properties.description: Enable SaaS mode with multi-tenant Stripe Connect support. When true, each tenant can have their own Stripe account for receiving payments.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.payment.stripe.api-key
properties.description: Stripe Secret API Key (sk_...) for payment processing. Keep this secure and never commit to version control. Use environment variables or secrets management.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.payment.stripe.webhook-secret
properties.description: Stripe Webhook Signing Secret (whsec_...) for verifying webhook event authenticity. Obtained from Stripe Dashboard when creating a webhook endpoint.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.payment.stripe.client-id
properties.description: Stripe Connect Client ID (ca_...) for OAuth flow during merchant onboarding. Required when saas-mode is enabled.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.stripe.public-key
properties.description: Stripe Publishable Key (pk_...) for client-side operations. Safe to expose in frontend applications.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.stripe.secret-key
properties.description: Stripe Secret Key (sk_...) for server-side API operations. Keep secure and never expose to clients.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.stripe.webhook-secret
properties.description: Stripe Webhook Signing Secret (whsec_...) for verifying general webhook events from Stripe.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.stripe.connect-client-id
properties.description: Stripe Connect Client ID (ca_...) for merchant onboarding via OAuth. Used to connect merchant Stripe accounts to the platform.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.notifications.enable-email-notifications
properties.description: Enable email notifications for billing events (payments, refunds, invoices). Disable for testing or when email service is unavailable.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.notifications.enable-webhook-notifications
properties.description: Enable webhook notifications for billing events. Allows external systems to receive real-time billing event updates.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.notifications.retry-delay
properties.description: Delay duration between notification retry attempts when delivery fails. Format: ISO-8601 duration (e.g., 'PT5S' for 5 seconds).

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.notifications.max-retries
properties.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed notification deliveries. Valid range: 1-10.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.subscription.enable-subscriptions
properties.description: Enable subscription management features. When false, subscription-related endpoints and processing are disabled.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.subscription.trial-period-days
properties.description: Number of days for the trial period when a new subscription is created. Set to 0 to disable trial periods. Valid range: 0-365.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.subscription.grace-period-days
properties.description: Number of days to allow after a failed payment before suspending the subscription. Valid range: 0-30.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.subscription.max-retry-attempts
properties.description: Maximum number of payment retry attempts for failed subscription payments. Valid range: 1-10.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.subscription.auto-cancel-after-days
properties.description: Number of days after which a suspended subscription will be automatically canceled if payment is not received. Valid range: 1-90.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.subscription.proration-behavior
properties.description: Proration behavior when subscription plans are changed mid-cycle. Valid values: CREATE_PRORATIONS (default, creates prorated charges/credits), NONE (no proration), ALWAYS_INVOICE (always create an invoice for prorations).

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.subscription.notifications.trial-ending-days-notice
properties.description: Number of days before trial ends to send a notification to the customer. Valid range: 1-30.

properties.name: iqscaffold.billing.subscription.notifications.payment-retry-schedule
properties.description: List of days after initial payment failure when retry attempts should be made. Must be in ascending order. Example: [1, 3, 5, 7] means retry on day 1, 3, 5, and 7 after failure.

values.description: Use Stripe as the payment provider for production payment processing.
Use manual payment processing for testing and development (no actual charges).
Standard SMTP submission port with STARTTLS encryption (recommended).
Standard SMTP port without encryption (not recommended for client use).
No caching - reload messages on every request (development mode).
Default retry count - balanced between reliability and performance.
Higher retries - more resilient to transient failures.
Create prorated charges or credits when subscription plans change mid-cycle (recommended).
No proration - changes take effect at the next billing cycle.
Always create an invoice immediately for any prorated amounts.
No trial period - subscription starts with immediate billing.
No grace period - suspend immediately on payment failure.
